name: Coupon SERP - Paste Brands and Run

parameters.formDescription: Paste one brand per line in this format: Brand|domain|country

parameters.jsCode:
return (function buildCompletePrompt($input) {
  return $input.all().map(({json:item})=>{
    const brand=String(item.brand??"").trim();
    const country=String(item.country??"").trim();
    const domain=String(item.domain??"").trim().replace(/^https?:\/\//i,"").replace(/^www\./i,"").replace(/\/.*$/,"");
    if(!brand||!country||!domain) throw new Error("Each search item needs brand, country and domain");
    const officialUrl="https://"+domain+"/";
    const sources=(item.results??[]).map(r=>String(r.url??"").trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10);
    const sourceList=sources.map((url,i)=>`${i+1}. ${url}`).join("\n");
    const slug=brand.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g,"-").replace(/^-|-$/g,"");
    const skiHint=/(^|\.)ski-planet\.com$/i.test(domain)
      ? [
          "For Ski-planet (travel bookings), inspect current promotions on these OFFICIAL pages:",
          "https://www.ski-planet.com/fr/promo-ski.php",
          "https://www.ski-planet.com/fr/derniere-minute-ski.php?Order=promo",
          "https://www.ski-planet.com/fr/code-promo-ski.php",
          "Treat them as leads; independently verify current availability, applicable dates and terms."
        ] : [];
    const prompt=[
      `RESEARCH ONE BRAND COMPLETELY: ${brand} | ${domain} | ${country}`,
      "Execute these THREE steps IN ORDER in one browser-agent task. Do not stop after the first two codes. Use real website inspection, not predictions.",
      "",
      "THE TWO DISTINCT INPUTS",
      `COUPON DISCOVERY SOURCES: The following ${sources.length} Serper result URLs ONLY (maximum 10).`,
      sourceList||"(No coupon source URLs supplied. Never invent any.)",
      "",
      `EXTRA OFFICIAL BRAND URL: ${officialUrl}`,
      "This official brand URL is FOR STEP 2 (deals) and STEP 3 (checkout verification); it does NOT replace any of the coupon discovery URLs. You may follow internal official-site links for these two steps.",
      "",
      "STEP 1 — EXTRACT ALL COUPON CODES FROM THE SUPPLIED SOURCE URLs",
      `Visit EACH of the ${sources.length} URLs, in listed order, and inspect the source page.`,
      "On each accessible page, extract up to the FIRST 10 distinct, explicitly revealed coupon/promo codes belonging to this brand.",
      "Click Show Code / Reveal / View / Copy / Get Code when needed, inspect the resulting DOM/modal/popup/new tab and clipboard if available, and return to the same source after merchant redirects.",
      "Never treat coupon amounts, promo slogans, sale text, generic words or unrelated merchants' codes as coupon codes.",
      "Preserve the code exactly as displayed (case, punctuation, symbols). Skip explicitly expired codes. Do not search Google or use additional coupon sources.",
      "KEEP A PERSISTENT STEP-1 COUPON LEDGER: save brand, country, source_url and each extracted code as soon as found. Never discard, summarize, shorten, replace or overwrite this ledger in later steps.",
      "Track for EACH source whether visited, extracted/no_code/blocked/error, and the count of distinct codes observed. Do not call Step 1 completed until all supplied URLs have been attempted.",
      "If the same code appears on different URLs, keep those source associations in the discovery CSV. At verification time deduplicate code tests case-insensitively while preserving source links.",
      "Create the COUPON CSV immediately upon finishing Step 1 with exactly these columns:",
      "brand,country,source_url,coupon_code,status",
      "One row per actual extracted coupon code; status=extracted. Never create fake codes or blank coupon_code rows. If no codes found, output header only.",
      "",
      "STEP 2 — RESEARCH CURRENT DEALS ON THE OFFICIAL BRAND WEBSITE",
      `Now visit ${officialUrl} and appropriate internal official-site pages. DO NOT revisit coupon directories or start another Google search.`,
      "Inspect homepage, promotion/sale sections, and navigation for current offers—not just one banner.",
      "Adapt to the business: retail=product sale/clearance; travel=bookable stays, packages, last-minute and early-bird offers; telecom/SaaS/services=promotional subscription plans, first-month prices and waived fees.",
      "For physical products only, inspect free or discounted shipping thresholds. Travel/digital services generally have no applicable shipping offer.",
      "Check newsletter/email/SMS/first-order signup ONLY where a real discount/benefit is explicitly stated, not merely because a signup form exists.",
      "Capture exact official source URL, precise deal text, qualifying conditions and current price/discount when actually displayed.",
      "Calculate min/max sale prices and min/max percentage discounts ONLY from matched original and discounted prices for the SAME product, plan, room/stay and date range. Never mix unrelated prices.",
      ...skiHint,
      "Create DEALS CSV, one row per verified actual offer, with exactly these columns:",
      "brand,country,website,deal_type,source_url,deal_text,lowest_sale_price,highest_sale_price,currency,min_discount_percent,max_discount_percent",
      "deal_type=sale,shipping,newsletter. Classify travel booking/telecom promotional prices as sale. Leave unknown or inapplicable numeric cells empty.",
      "If no current deal is verifiable, output only the header. Do not invent a deal or treat ordinary shipping service as an offer.",
      "",
      "STEP 3 — TEST EVERY UNIQUE STEP-1 CODE ON THE OFFICIAL BRAND WEBSITE",
      `Remain on (or return to) ${officialUrl} and use ONLY that merchant's actual cart/checkout/booking/plan-selection pages and genuine merchant checkout subdomains.`,
      "Use the EXACT saved Step-1 coupon ledger. DO NOT re-extract, re-rank or limit the codes to the two most promising ones.",
      "Enumerate and COUNT the case-insensitively distinct codes from the ledger BEFORE testing. Every one must have a verification CSV row, regardless of test outcome.",
      "For retail: choose one representative purchasable product, select required options, add to cart and find the real promo-code field. For travel: select plausible destination/stay/dates where available and reach booking summary; for telecom/subscriptions: select an eligible plan and reach its discount/checkout field.",
      "Apply codes ONE BY ONE; reset any previous promo code before testing the next code. If a code has eligibility restrictions, inspect the visible explanation and do not misclassify it as invalid.",
      "verified_valid: official merchant visibly accepts the code AND actually applies a measurable discount to the subtotal.",
      "verified_invalid: official merchant explicitly rejects the code as invalid/expired.",
      "conditions_not_met: merchant states min spend, eligible customer/product/date/plan or other restrictions; validity not demonstrated.",
      "not_testable: no promo field, blocked site, required signup/login/payment, inaccessible checkout, too little information or inconclusive outcome.",
      "Never mark a code valid based solely on the coupon source or published deal. Do not pretend to have entered a code unless you actually did.",
      "Do not register, log in, provide personal/payment details, evade CAPTCHA/security restrictions, place an order or complete a purchase.",
      "If a source code could not be tested, KEEP IT and mark not_testable with an accurate explanation. Do not silently omit difficult codes.",
      "Create VERIFICATION CSV with exactly these columns:",
      "brand,country,coupon_code,verification_status,source_urls,official_test_url,cart_subtotal,currency,discount_applied,evidence",
      "Output one row per unique code. Combine the associated source URLs using semicolons. Quote CSV fields as required.",
      "",
      "FINAL COMPLETENESS CHECK — MANDATORY",
      "Before responding, compare the saved Step-1 ledger with the coupon CSV: every extracted code/source pair must appear. Do not lose codes just because later research was lengthy.",
      "Compare the distinct code count with verification CSV data-row count: the counts must match EXACTLY.",
      "Do not reduce a large discovery set to two example codes. If testing is unfinished, include all untested discovered codes with not_testable plus an honest explanation; never fabricate tests.",
      "If website access or execution limits interrupt research, report coverage truthfully and retain all results already observed; do not claim the full workflow finished.",
      "",
      "FINAL OUTPUT — THREE SEPARATE DOWNLOADABLE CSV FILES (NOT JSON):",
      `1. ${slug}-coupons.csv`,
      `2. ${slug}-deals.csv`,
      `3. ${slug}-verification.csv`,
      "Attach real .csv files if file-generation tools are available. Otherwise provide THREE separately named CSV code blocks, each with its header, so they can be saved independently.",
      "Use proper CSV quoting: double-quote fields containing commas, quotes or line breaks; double any embedded quote. No invented codes, deals, applied discounts or verification outcomes."
    ].join("\n");
    return {json:{
      brand,domain,country,officialUrl,sourceUrlCount:sources.length,
      sources:sources.map((url,i)=>({position:i+1,url})),
      masterPrompt:prompt
    }};
  });
})($input);
